reviews.text: We took our two pets to the groomer and our experience was excellent. The service they provided to us and our pets was outstanding. They are true professionals and it gives me great peace of mind to take them there. Thank you so much.
Big
They always treat my princesses with so much love and care, I recommend them 10000% ❤️
I take my dog ​​to the groomer! They make her look beautiful and the girls are super sweet 🩷

Hello, the staff at Clínica Avenida are wonderful, friendly, and always attentive to my pet Juanan.
Keep up the good work! Hugs to everyone.
Excellent hair salon. Friendly service and great professionalism.

We are delighted with the care our dog Blanca receives. From day one, she has been treated with immense love, patience, and professionalism. It's clear they genuinely love animals, and that gives us enormous peace of mind every time we take her.

The veterinary care is excellent—always friendly, attentive, and explaining everything clearly.

We are also thrilled with the grooming service. They treat Blanca wonderfully, and she always leaves looking gorgeous, perfectly groomed, and happy.

A fantastic team, both at the veterinary clinic and the grooming salon. Blanca is in very good hands, and we are so glad we found them. Highly recommended.

Terrible experience with the vets. I took both my cats in for different things, and everything went wrong. My cat, who has tartar buildup on his teeth, was told that the best thing to do was to have all his teeth removed. They didn't suggest any alternatives beforehand. With my cat, whom I took in because she had a kind of cold that turned out to be pneumonia, I left her there, and the next day when I picked her up, she was shivering from the cold and soaking wet—even worse than when I left her. And when I complained, they were disrespectful, giving us a very exaggerated diagnosis, even suggesting it could be cancer. In short, I strongly advise everyone I know not to go to this place.
Excellent service, friendly and caring staff, and the one who bathed my dogs was very kind and affectionate!

They've been taking care of this rascal for over two years now, and he's always getting into trouble 🫣 but he's always happy and eager to come back. An incredible professional team who have managed to make Haru feel better every time. Here's to many more years of caring for him 🤗 …
I'm delighted with how Ane and her team treat my feline children.

Elena is very professional and treats my pet like she's her own. She did a fantastic job with Catalina.
Thank you, Elena!
The service at the clinic was wonderful. My dog ​​is so happy; he's a big dog, and Elena trimmed his nails in a flash. He got his vaccinations, and everything was great. We're delighted!
Everything was great and the service was excellent.

I had a terrible experience with this clinic. They scammed us. They gave my dog ​​a vaccine that made her very sick. The first time, they gave her one vaccine and said she'd get a booster in three weeks. Yesterday, we took her back for the booster, and they gave her the wrong one. Now we have to go back in three weeks for another booster. When we went the first time, they never mentioned this; they just said it was a booster, nothing more. They're only interested in money. We're going to report them. Besides, the service is awful, and the manager is even worse. Plus, it's a different doctor every day. I absolutely do not recommend them.
I'm so happy! My little guy got a haircut and a bath. He's getting older now, and they took great care of him and made him look gorgeous. They're professionals and they love our pets. Thank you!

I'm delighted with them. Very friendly, kind, excellent service, they really care about the pets…

I went for the first time a couple of years ago because my dog ​​broke a toe, and they treated us wonderfully. As a diagnosis, they gave us the choice between surgery or amputation, and in both cases, they explained the pros and cons very well. Everything was handled through the clinic with a specialist. We decided on surgery (with follow-up appointments, at a good price, and x-rays), and a year later, she was doing great; she walks, runs, plays, etc.

Since then, we've continued going to the clinic for vaccinations, emergencies, etc.

It's also her first time at the groomer's, and she left very happy, and so did I. They deshed her beautifully; she's super clean and white.

I highly recommend them.

Despite not having been with the clinic for very long, they are great professionals and treat my dogs wonderfully, with lots of love both at the grooming and veterinary clinics. I recommend them to everyone.

I take my Pomeranian to both the vet and the groomer, and we're thrilled. They're always very professional, and every time they bathe and groom her, they make her look absolutely gorgeous, and the price is fantastic! Plus, my dog ​​loves going! Highly recommended!!!
We love taking care of Marty with you all, a kiss to Elena 💋 …
This is the second time I've taken my dog ​​to the groomer and the girls are professional and very nice.

A heartfelt thank you to that amazing team of professionals for caring for and pampering my kitties, both those who have passed away and those I'm caring for now with all the love in the world. Special thanks to Sara and Alejandro for saving Limón's life, and to Elena, Anne, and Andrea for pampering him while he was hospitalized. Thank you so much for everything, everyone! 💜
We started going there on a friend's recommendation, and so far we're very happy with the care; they're treating our kitten wonderfully. We'll definitely continue to trust this clinic.
Excellent work, attention, and care for my furry friend. I feel confident that he's in good hands 🥇🏆 …

Our experience has been excellent. We've been taking our dog there for many years, and the attention, care, and treatment have been unbeatable. The team is outstandingly professional, with all the necessary resources, and above all, they never performed unnecessary tests, always prioritizing the animal's well-being over business. We will be eternally grateful to this clinic and its wonderful staff, led by Sara.
Very professional and especially caring with pets.
Excellent service, a pleasure

I want to express my gratitude for the excellent service I received over the phone today. I'm not a regular customer, yet you listened patiently, offered guidance, and reassured me during a moment of worry for my dog. Your dedication and love for animals are evident. Thank you so much.

They're very patient with the kitten and his admission (he's a real eater). They're very gentle with the big one every time we go. With the little one—the pellet, bronchitis, and a few other things—we're getting him back on his feet. They're very professional.
The prices aren't outrageous; you can tell they love their work.
Excellent service. The neurologist was incredibly professional, as was the reception staff. Thank you so much for everything.
A highly recommended place for our furry friends; excellent attention and dedication.
I was very pleased with Dr. Maria's service. I was able to get an appointment the same day.
Very good service

After having terrible experiences with two clinics in the area, this is the only clinic I've been going to for almost two years, and I completely trust them with my two big boys. They certainly have their share of health issues.
It's true that I'd single out some vets over others, based on personal experience, like Alejandro, who always treats Nobu as if he were his own. And Sara with Shiro, who always explained things to me very professionally and even managed to guide me when I was overwhelmed with all of their problems.
The reception staff are also wonderful—the tattoo artist, the groomer—they've always treated us with exquisite kindness. For now, I don't plan on changing this clinic for anything, and I hope it stays that way for many years to come 💕

I took my dog ​​to the groomer today and the experience couldn't have been better. The way they treated both me and my pet was a 10 out of 10. They are true professionals and give me a lot of peace of mind. Thank you all.

My dog ​​Rambo was admitted and the care he received was outstanding. The professionals are excellent, and best of all is the empathy and kindness of the entire team. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.

The service was exceptional, fast, and highly professional from the entire team. We were seen by Alejandro, a wonderful veterinarian who was attentive and involved from the first minute to the last. Leaving your pet in good hands and knowing they'll be treated exceptionally well is priceless.

Excellent service and professionalism.

Very happy.

I've been going to the clinic with my Luna for a while now, both for the veterinary and grooming services. I'm very happy with the service because Elena, the groomer, is so sweet with my Luna and always makes her look gorgeous. I recommend it one hundred percent.

A month ago my Laika got sick, and thanks to Alicia and Helena, she's back to her old self. They are wonderful, and their dedication is evident. A 10 out of 10 for the clinic, but especially for them. Thank you.
They are lovely. I cut my dog's hair, a Bichon, and they make him look gorgeous.

I only have words of gratitude for the entire clinic team. We arrived terrified after another clinic told us Jai had pancreatitis and his condition wasn't improving. Here, they not only reviewed everything from scratch with professionalism and rigor, but they went above and beyond to arrive at the correct diagnosis.

From the very first moment, we felt supported. They were attentive, caring, and extremely careful with every test, every explanation, and every decision. They spoke to us clearly, without alarming us, but without downplaying anything. And that, when it comes to your dog, is everything.

Thanks to their work, patience, and follow-up, Jai is doing well today, has regained weight and quality of life. And we have peace of mind.

It's not just a veterinary clinic; it's a team that is truly dedicated.

Thank you for taking such good care of your dog.

Highly recommended clinic. We've always taken our dog (Teddy) there, and the service has always been outstanding—very attentive and always looking out for his best interests. Scheduling appointments, consultations, and follow-ups is excellent. They also have a fantastic grooming service. In short, a wonderful team.

I do not recommend this clinic. After negligence during my pet's surgery, they washed their hands of the problem and were only concerned with getting paid.
Contradictory treatment and a lack of proper medical follow-up.
Thanks to another clinic, my cat is better, but I will never return here.
It's a shame that Google won't let me upload the images (due to sensitive content) of the infection my pet developed so people could see the extent of the problem.

EDIT: How can you have the nerve to claim that my pet recovered well, even though you admitted your mistake on-site, when I had to rush my pet to the hospital after that "proper surgery or treatment"? You gave us ridiculous instructions that only reopened and infected my pet's wound. The hospital that performed the surgery even offered to provide a report to submit to the veterinary association. What you did was a botched job, plain and simple. A botched job that, if it had been acknowledged, would have been fixed, but you have to keep a good impression on the public, right?

And thank goodness you at least got one thing right, didn't you? A proper response to such negligence... Oh well...
